Name: Rose Colored Glasses -- A Map Recolor
Author: vamoosi
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8372]UPDATE: Go here for the 1.5 compatible version![/url]

Just like it says on the tin.

The aim here was for a less vibrant but not dreary map recolor, and I put a pinkish tone over everything because I thought it was cute. What can I say, I thrive off of unnecessary projects. 

Includes all basic outdoor maps, trees, the desert, and mine levels as well. Also includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/816]Ali's flower grass[/url] in matching tones. Doesn't touch most of the buildings, but I did tone down the Oasis building because it was a little ... much.
